# A CVE the model never scores, even when asked again, fails the run at the
# end: the CVE is named, and neither the VEX nor the attestation is written.

env VENS_MOCK_LLM_SKIP=CVE-2024-5678
! exec vens generate --llm=mock --attest --config-file=config.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'model returned no score for 1 of 2 vulnerabilities, after asking again: CVE-2024-5678'
! exists out.cdx.json
! exists out.attestation.cdx.json
! exec sh -c 'ls .vens-*.tmp'

-- config.yaml --
project:
  name: "unscored-cve-test"
  description: "A CVE the model never scores"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
